bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties

title.zh: 卷四十五 唐書21: 閔帝本紀
title.en: Volume 45 Book of Later Tang 21: Emperor Min Annals 1
title.raw: 卷四十五 唐書21: 閔帝本紀 Volume 45 Book of Later Tang 21: Emperor Min Annals 1

sentences.zh: 閔帝，諱從厚，小字菩薩奴，明宗第三子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Min, taboo name Conghou, childhood name Pusa Nu, was Mingzong's third son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Min, whose taboo name was Conghou and childhood name Pusa Nu, was Mingzong's third son.

sentences.zh: 母昭懿皇后夏氏，以天祐十一年歲在甲戌，十一月二十八日庚申，生帝於晉陽舊第。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Zhaoyi, Lady Xia. In the eleventh year of Tianyou, the year in jiaxu, on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month, gengshen day, the Emperor was born at the old residence in Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zhaoyi, Lady Xia. On gengshen, the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month in jiaxu—the eleventh year of Tianyou—he was born at the old residence in Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 帝髫齔好讀《春秋》，略通大義，貌類明宗，尤鍾愛。

translations.literal: From childhood the Emperor loved reading the Spring and Autumn Annals and had a grasp of its main meaning; his appearance resembled Mingzong's, and he was especially cherished.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he loved reading the Spring and Autumn Annals and understood its main themes; he looked like Mingzong and was especially favored.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月二十日，秦王誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on the twentieth day of the eleventh month, the Prince of Qin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the twentieth day of the eleventh month, the Prince of Qin was put to death.

sentences.zh: 翌日，明宗遣宣徽使孟漢瓊馳驛召帝，二十六日，明宗崩，二十九日，帝至自鄴。

translations.literal: The next day Mingzong dispatched Palace Secretariat commissioner Meng Hanqiong by express relay to summon the Emperor; on the twenty-sixth Mingzong died; on the twenty-ninth the Emperor arrived from Ye.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Mingzong sent palace secretariat commissioner Meng Hanqiong by relay to summon Conghou. Mingzong died on the twenty-sixth, and the emperor arrived from Ye on the twenty-ninth.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，發喪於西宮，帝於柩前即位。

translations.literal: On guimao, the new moon of the twelfth month, mourning was launched at the Western Palace; the Emperor took the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon of the twelfth month mourning was proclaimed at the Western Palace, and Conghou took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 丁未，群臣上表請聽政，表再上，詔允。

translations.literal: On dingwei the hundred officials submitted memorials requesting that he hear government; the memorial was submitted again, and an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei officials submitted memorials asking him to assume rule; they submitted again, and an edict granted the request.

sentences.zh: 己酉，中外將士給賜有差。

translations.literal: On jiwei troops civil and military within and without were given rewards in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei court and field forces received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝縗服見群臣於廣壽門之東廡下，宰臣馮道進曰：「陛下久居哀毀，臣等鹹願一睹聖顏。

translations.literal: On gengxu the Emperor in hemp mourning garb received the hundred officials in the eastern corridor beneath Guangshou Gate; Grand Councilor Feng Dao advanced and said, "Your Majesty has long dwelt in mourning grief; we all wish to behold the sage countenance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the emperor, still in mourning hemp, received officials in the eastern portico of Guangshou Gate. Grand councilor Feng Dao stepped forward: "Your Majesty has mourned so long—we all long to see your face.

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭前舉帽，群臣再拜而退。

translations.literal: " Zhu Hongzhao stepped forward and raised the hat; the hundred officials bowed again and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao stepped forward and raised the hat; the officials bowed again and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 禦光政樓存問軍民。

translations.literal: He took Guangzheng Tower to inquire after soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: He appeared at Guangzheng Tower to address soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜司衣王氏死，坐秦王事也。

translations.literal: On xinhai the palace dress steward Lady Wang was put to death, on account of the Prince of Qin's affair.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai palace dress steward Lady Wang was executed in connection with the Prince of Qin case.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以前鎮州節度使、涇王從敏權知河南府事，尋以盧質代之。

translations.literal: On guichou former Zhen prefecture military commissioner and Prince of Jing Cong Min was made acting Henan prefect; soon Lu Zhi replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou former Zhenzhou commissioner and Prince of Jing Cong Min was named acting Henan prefect, but Lu Zhi soon replaced him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜司儀康氏死，事連王氏也。

translations.literal: On yimao the palace ritual steward Lady Kang was put to death, the case being linked to Lady Wang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao palace ritual steward Lady Kang was executed in the same investigation as Lady Wang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以天雄軍節度判官唐汭為諫議大夫，掌書記趙彖為起居郎，元從都押衙宋令詢為磁州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingchen Tianxiong army military commissioner's judge Tang Ni was made Remonstrance and Criticism Grand Master; secretarial aide Zhao Luan was made Diarist; original follower chief military adjutant Song Lingxun was made Ci prefectural governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Tang Ni, adjutant to the Tianxiong commissioner, became Remonstrance and Criticism Grand Master; Zhao Luan, secretary, became diarist; and Song Lingxun, chief adjutant from the old retinue, became prefect of Ci.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以左僕射、平章事馮道為山陵使，戶部尚書韓彥惲為副，中書舍人王延為判官，禮部尚書王權為禮儀使，兵部尚書李鈴為鹵簿使，御史中丞龍敏為儀仗使，右僕射、權知河南府盧質為橋道頓遞使。

translations.literal: On dingsi Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Councilor Feng Dao was made imperial tomb commissioner; Minister of Revenue Han Yanhun vice commissioner; Secretariat Drafting Officer Wang Yan judge; Minister of Rites Wang Quan ritual commissioner; Minister of War Li Ling ceremonial escort commissioner; Vice Censor-in-chief Long Min ceremonial guard commissioner; Right Vice Director and acting Henan prefect Lu Zhi bridge-road relay commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi left vice director and grand councilor Feng Dao was named imperial tomb commissioner, with Han Yanhun as deputy, Wang Yan as judge, Wang Quan as ritual commissioner, Li Ling as escort commissioner, Long Min as guard commissioner, and Lu Zhi, right vice director and acting Henan prefect, as bridge-and-relay commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前相州刺史郝瓊為右驍衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使；

translations.literal: On gengshen former Yan prefecture governor Hao Qiong was made Right Undaunted Guard general-in-chief and filled the post of Northern Courtyard Palace Secretariat commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen former Yanzhou governor Hao Qiong became Right Undaunted Guard general-in-chief and Northern Courtyard palace secretariat commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以光祿卿、充三司副使王玫為三司使。

translations.literal: Court Provisioner and deputy Three Departments commissioner Wang Mei was made Three Departments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Court provisioner and deputy Three Departments commissioner Wang Mei became Three Departments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，故檢校太尉、右衛上將軍、充三司使孫嶽贈太尉、齊國公。

translations.literal: On guihai the late honorary Grand Commandant, Right Guard senior general, and Three Departments commissioner Sun Yue was posthumously given Grand Commandant and Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the late honorary grand commandant Sun Yue, senior general of the Right Guard and Three Departments commissioner, was posthumously made grand commandant and Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝釋縗服，群臣三上表，請復常膳，禦正殿，從之。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Emperor doffed hemp mourning garb; the hundred officials submitted memorials three times requesting return to regular meals and taking the main hall; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor ended mourning dress. Officials memorialized three times asking him to resume normal meals and hold court in the main hall, and he agreed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，帝御中興殿，群臣列位，馮道升階進酒。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Emperor took Zhongxing Hall; the hundred officials took their places; Feng Dao ascended the steps and presented wine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the emperor held court in Zhongxing Hall. Officials took their ranks, and Feng Dao ascended to offer wine.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「比於此物無愛，除賓友之會，不近樽斝。

translations.literal: The Emperor said, "Regarding this thing I have no fondness; apart from gatherings with guests and friends, I do not approach cups and jars.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I have no taste for this; except at gatherings with friends I do not touch wine.

sentences.zh: 況在沉痛之中，安事飲啖！

translations.literal: How, amid deep grief, can I attend to eating and drinking!"
translations.idiomatic: In deep mourning, why would I eat and drink!"

sentences.zh: 」命徹之。

translations.literal: " He ordered it withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the wine removed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宰臣馮道加司空，李愚加右僕射，劉煦加吏部尚書，餘並如故。

translations.literal: On gengchen Grand Councilor Feng Dao was additionally made Minister of Works; Li Yu Right Vice Director; Liu Xu Minister of Personnel—all others as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen grand councilor Feng Dao was also named Minister of Works; Li Yu became right vice director; Liu Xu became Minister of Personnel; others kept their posts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、河陽節度使康義誠加檢校太尉、兼侍中，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: On renwu Personal Guard horse-and-foot overall commander and Heyang military commissioner Kang Yicheng was additionally made honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant, overseeing the Six Armies and various guard units.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Kang Yicheng, overall commander of the Personal Guard and Heyang commissioner, was also named honorary grand commandant and palace attendant with charge of the Six Armies and palace guards.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、寧國軍節度使安彥威為河中節度使；

translations.literal: On jiashen Personal Guard cavalry overall commander and Ningguo army military commissioner An Yanwei was made Hezhong military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen An Yanwei, Personal Guard cavalry commander and Ningguo commissioner, became Hezhong commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、忠正軍節度使張從賓為涇州節度使，並加檢校太傅；

translations.literal: Personal Guard infantry overall commander and Zhongzheng army military commissioner Zhang Congbin was made Jing prefecture military commissioner, both additionally honorary Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Congbin, infantry commander and Zhongzheng commissioner, became Jingzhou commissioner; both were also named honorary grand tutor;

sentences.zh: 以捧聖左右廂都指揮使、欽州刺史朱洪實為寧國軍節度使，加檢校太保，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Left and Right Banners overall commander of the Sacred Guard and Qin prefectural governor Zhu Hongshi was made Ningguo army military commissioner, additionally honorary Grand Guardian, filling the post of Personal Guard cavalry overall commander;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongshi of the Sacred Guard and Qinzhou was made Ningguo commissioner, honorary grand guardian, and Personal Guard cavalry commander;

sentences.zh: 以嚴衛左右廂都指揮使、岩州刺史皇甫遇為忠正軍節度使、檢校太保，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Left and Right Banners overall commander of the Strict Guard and Yan prefectural governor Huangfu Yu was made Zhongzheng army military commissioner and honorary Grand Guardian, filling the post of Personal Guard infantry overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu of the Strict Guard and Yanzhou became Zhongzheng commissioner and honorary grand guardian, commanding Personal Guard infantry.

sentences.zh: 戊子，樞密使、檢校太尉、同平章事朱宏昭，樞密使、檢校太尉、同中書門下二品馮贇並加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On wuzi Military Affairs Commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and Associate Grand Councilor Zhu Hongzhao, and Military Affairs Commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery Feng Yun were both additionally made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhu Hongzhao and Feng Yun, both military affairs commissioners and honorary grand commandants, were also named director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 北京留守、河東節度使兼大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管石敬瑭加兼中書令；

translations.literal: Northern Capital regent, Hedong military commissioner, and overall commander of Han and barbarian horse and foot of the Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies Shi Jingtang was additionally made concurrent Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Northern Capital regent and Hedong commissioner Shi Jingtang, overall commander of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and allied horse and foot, was also named director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令趙德鈞加檢校太師、兼中書令。

translations.literal: You prefecture military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Zhao Dejun was additionally made honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou commissioner Zhao Dejun, honorary grand commandant and director of the Secretariat, was also named honorary grand preceptor and director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 樞密使馮贇表堅讓中書令，製改兼侍中，封邠國公。

translations.literal: Military Affairs Commissioner Feng Yun submitted a memorial firmly declining Director of the Secretariat; an edict changed it to concurrent Palace Attendant, enfeoffed as Duke of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yun firmly declined director of the Secretariat in a memorial; the edict changed the appointment to palace attendant instead and enfeoffed him as Duke of Bin.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂加兼侍中；

translations.literal: On gengyin Fengxiang military commissioner and Prince of Lu Cong Ke was additionally made concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Fengxiang commissioner and Prince of Lu Cong Ke was also named palace attendant;

sentences.zh: 青州節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令房知溫加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Qing prefecture military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Fang Zhiwen was additionally made honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou commissioner Fang Zhiwen, honorary grand commandant and director of the Secretariat, was also named honorary grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以翰林學士承旨、尚書右丞李懌為工部尚書，以秘書監盧文紀為太常卿，充山陵禮儀使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Hanlin academician-in-chief and Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Li Yi was made Minister of Works; Director of the Palace Library Lu Wenji was made Director of Imperial Sacrifices, filling the post of imperial tomb ritual commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Hanlin academician-in-chief Li Yi became Minister of Works; Lu Wenji, director of the palace library, became Director of Imperial Sacrifices and imperial tomb ritual commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，荊南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令高從誨封南平王；

translations.literal: On renchen Jingnan military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Gao Conghui was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping;
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Jingnan commissioner Gao Conghui, honorary grand commandant and director of the Secretariat, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping;

sentences.zh: 湖南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令馬希範封楚王。

translations.literal: Hunan military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Ma Xifan was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xifan of Hunan, honorary grand commandant and director of the Secretariat, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 甲午，兩浙節度使、檢校太師、守中書令、吳王錢元瓘進封吳越王；

translations.literal: On jiawu Liang-Zhe military commissioner, honorary Grand Preceptor, acting Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Wu Qian Yuanguan was advanced in rank to Prince of Wuyue;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Qian Yuanguan of Liang-Zhe, honorary grand preceptor, acting director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Wu, was promoted to Prince of Wuyue;

sentences.zh: 前洺州團練使皇甫立加檢校太保，充鄜州節度使；

translations.literal: Former Luo regiment trainer Huangfu Li was additionally made honorary Grand Guardian, filling the post of Fu prefecture military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Former Luo regiment trainer Huangfu Li was also named honorary grand guardian and Fuzhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 前彰義軍節度使康福加檢校太傅，充邠州節度使；

translations.literal: Former Zhangyi army military commissioner Kang Fu was additionally made honorary Grand Tutor, filling the post of Bin prefecture military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Former Zhangyi commissioner Kang Fu was also named honorary grand tutor and Binzhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 劍南東、西兩川節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、蜀王孟知祥加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Eastern and Western Jiannan circuits military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Shu Meng Zhixiang was additionally made honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhixiang of eastern and western Jiannan, honorary grand commandant, director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Shu, was also named honorary grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 製下，知祥辭不受命。

translations.literal: When the decree was issued, Zhixiang declined and did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict came down, Meng Zhixiang refused the appointment.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鎮州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中範延光，汴州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中趙延壽，並加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On bingshen Zhen prefecture military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant Fan Yanguang, and Bian prefecture military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant Zhao Yanshou, were both additionally made honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Fan Yanguang of Zhenzhou and Zhao Yanshou of Bianzhou, both honorary grand commandants and palace attendants, were also named honorary grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，山南西道節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事張虔釗，襄州節度使趙在禮，並加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On wuxu Shannan West Circuit military commissioner, honorary Grand Tutor, and Associate Grand Councilor Zhang Qianzhao, and Xiang prefecture military commissioner Zhao Zaili, were both additionally made honorary Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhang Qianzhao of Shannan West and Xiangzhou commissioner Zhao Zaili were both named honorary grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以振武軍節度使、安北都護楊檀兼大同、彰國、振武、威塞等軍都虞候，充北面馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Zhenwu army military commissioner and Protector-General of Pacifying the North Yang Tan was additionally made overall adjutant of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies, filling the post of overall northern cavalry commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yang Tan of Zhenwu and Protector-General of Pacifying the North was also named overall adjutant of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and allied armies and northern cavalry commander.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅朔，群臣赴西宮臨。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the intercalary month, renchen, the hundred officials went to the Western Palace for the mourning visit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the intercalary month officials attended mourning at the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，禦文明殿入閣。

translations.literal: On guimao he took Civilization Hall and entered the court session.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he held court at Civilization Hall.

sentences.zh: 以前右僕射、權知河南府事盧質為太子少傅兼河南尹。

translations.literal: Former Right Vice Director and acting Henan prefect Lu Zhi was made Junior Mentor to the Heir Apparent and concurrent Henan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Former right vice director and acting Henan prefect Lu Zhi became junior mentor to the heir apparent and Henan prefect.

sentences.zh: 以諫議大夫唐汭、膳部郎中知制誥陳乂並為給事中，充樞密院直學士。

translations.literal: Remonstrance and Criticism Grand Master Tang Ni and Board of Rites bureau director and drafter of edicts Chen Yi were both made Supervising Secretariat Drafters, filling posts as direct academicians of the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ni, remonstrance grand master, and Chen Yi, Board of Rites director and edict drafter, both became supervising drafters and direct academicians of the Military Affairs Bureau.

translations.literal: [Editorial supplement begins]
translations.idiomatic: [Supplement begins]

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：汭以文學從帝，曆三鎮在幕府。

translations.literal: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》: Ni followed the Emperor by literary talent and served at three military commissions in headquarters staff.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 says Tang Ni entered the emperor's service through literary talent and served on the staffs of three military commissions.

sentences.zh: 及即位，將佐之有才者，朱、馮皆斥逐之。

translations.literal: When he acceded to the throne, among aides of talent Zhu and Feng all drove them away.
translations.idiomatic: Once enthroned, Zhu and Feng drove away every talented aide.

sentences.zh: 汭性迂疏，朱、馮恐帝含怒有時而發，乃引汭於密近，以其黨陳乂監之。）〉

translations.literal: Ni by nature was blunt and undiscerning; Zhu and Feng feared the Emperor might harbor anger and release it in time, and so drew Ni into intimate proximity, setting Chen Yi of their faction to supervise him.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ni was blunt and naive; Zhu and Feng feared the emperor's anger might break out eventually, so they kept Ni close at hand and posted their ally Chen Yi to watch him.)〉

sentences.zh: 宣徽南院使、驃騎大將軍、左衛上將軍、知內侍省孟漢瓊加開府儀同三司，賜忠貞扶運保泰功臣。

translations.literal: Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, Flying Cavalry Grand General, Left Guard senior general, and acting Director of the Palace Domestic Service Meng Hanqiong was additionally made Open-House Three Excellencies Equal in Honor, and granted title Upright Loyalty, Support-the-Transport, Preserve-and-Secure Merit Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Hanqiong, southern palace secretariat commissioner and senior general of the Left Guard, was also named Open-House Three Excellencies Equal in Honor with the merit title Upright Loyalty, Support-the-Transport, Preserve-and-Secure.

sentences.zh: 丙午，正衙命使冊皇太后曹氏。

translations.literal: On bingwu at the main court an envoy was ordered to invest Empress Dowager Lady Cao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the court commissioned an envoy to invest Empress Dowager Cao.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以前雄武軍節度使劉仲殷為右衛上將軍，邢州節度使趙鳳加爵邑。

translations.literal: On wushen former Xiongwu army military commissioner Liu Zhongyin was made Right Guard senior general; Xing prefecture military commissioner Zhao Feng received additional ennoblement.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen former Xiongwu commissioner Liu Zhongyin became Right Guard senior general, and Xingzhou commissioner Zhao Feng received additional titles and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 自是諸藩鎮文武臣僚皆次第加恩，帝嗣位覃恩澤也。

translations.literal: From this all civil and military officials of the various military commissions were given favors in succession—it was the Emperor's grace upon acceding to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter civil and military officials across the circuits were rewarded in turn—a general amnesty for the new reign.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、中書舍人崔棁為工部侍郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician and Secretariat Drafting Officer Cui Chong was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing in his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Cui Chong became Vice Minister of Works while keeping his post.

sentences.zh: 以給事中張鵬為御史中丞，以御史中丞龍敏為兵部侍郎，以太僕少卿竇維為大理卿。

translations.literal: Supervising Drafter Zhang Peng was made Vice Censor-in-chief; Vice Censor-in-chief Long Min Minister of War; Court of the Imperial Stud junior director Dou Wei Director of the Court of Judicature and Revision.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising drafter Zhang Peng became vice censor-in-chief; Long Min became Minister of War; Dou Wei became director of the Court of Judicature and Revision.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，正衙命使冊皇太妃王氏。

translations.literal: On jiayin at the main court an envoy was ordered to invest Imperial Noble Consort Lady Wang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the court commissioned an envoy to invest Imperial Noble Consort Wang.

sentences.zh: 集賢院上言：「準敕書修創淩煙閣，尋奉詔問閣高下等級。

translations.literal: The Hall of Worthies submitted a memorial: "Per the imperial dispatch to restore and build the Lingyan Pavilion, we then received an edict inquiring about the pavilion's height and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Worthies reported: "By imperial order we are to rebuild the Lingyan Pavilion, and we have received an edict asking about its height and ranking.

sentences.zh: 謹按淩煙閣，都長安時在西內三清殿側，畫像皆北面，閣有中隔，隔內面北寫功高宰輔，南面寫功高諸侯王，隔外面次第圖畫功臣題讚。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that Lingyan Pavilion, when the capital was at Chang'an, stood beside the Three Pure Hall within the inner Western palace; portraits all faced north; the pavilion had a central partition—withinside facing north were painted high-merit chief ministers, facing south high-merit princes and kings; outside the partition worthy ministers were painted in sequence with eulogistic inscriptions.
translations.idiomatic: Lingyan Pavilion in Chang'an stood beside the Three Pure Hall in the inner palace. Portraits faced north; inside a central partition north-facing panels showed chief ministers of highest merit and south-facing panels regional princes; outside, meritorious ministers were painted in order with eulogies.

sentences.zh: 自西京板蕩，四十餘年，舊日主掌官吏及畫像工人，並已淪喪，集賢院所管寫真官、畫真官人數不少，都洛後廢職。

translations.literal: Since the disruption of the Western Capital, forty-odd years have passed; former chief managing officials and portrait painters have all perished; the Hall of Worthies oversaw many portrait draftsmen and portrait painters, but after establishing the capital at Luoyang the posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: More than forty years since the fall of Chang'an, the old managers and painters are gone. The Hall of Worthies once had many portrait officials, but the posts were abolished after the move to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 今將起閣，望先定佐命功臣人數，請下翰林院預令寫真本，及下將作監興功，次序間架修建。

translations.literal: Now that the pavilion is to be raised, we hope first to fix the number of founding merit ministers; we request that the Hanlin Academy be ordered in advance to prepare portrait drafts, and the Directorate of Palace Buildings be ordered to undertake construction and arrange the bays in order.
translations.idiomatic: Before rebuilding we ask to fix the number of founding ministers; let the Hanlin Academy prepare portrait drafts and the Directorate of Palace Buildings handle construction in proper sequence.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔集賢御書院復置寫真官、畫真官各一員，餘依所奏。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict restored one portrait draftsman and one portrait painter each in the Hall of Worthies and Imperial Calligraphy Academy; the rest followed what was memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict restored one portrait draftsman and one painter each to the Hall of Worthies and Imperial Calligraphy Academy, and approved the rest of the plan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，安州奏，此月七日夜，節度使符彥超為部曲王希全所害，廢朝一日。

translations.literal: On dingsi An prefecture reported that on the seventh night of this month military commissioner Fu Yanchao was killed by his troops under Wang Xiquan; mourning was suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Anzhou reported that on the seventh night of the month commissioner Fu Yanchao was killed by his officer Wang Xiquan; the court suspended audiences for one day.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前振武軍節度使、安北都護高行周為彰武節度使。

translations.literal: On wuwu former Zhenwu army military commissioner and Protector-General of Pacifying the North Gao Xingzhou was made Zhangwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu former Zhenwu commissioner and Protector-General Gao Xingzhou became Zhangwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前鄆州使範政為少府監。

translations.literal: On xinyou former Yan prefecture envoy Fan Zheng was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou former Yanzhou envoy Fan Zheng became director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin he visited Zhide Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he visited Zhide Palace.

sentences.zh: 車駕至興教門，有飛鳶自空而墜，僵於御前。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage reached Xingjiao Gate, a kite fell from the sky and lay stiff before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: At Xingjiao Gate a kite fell from the sky and dropped dead before the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 是日大風晦冥。

translations.literal: That day the wind was strong and the sky dark.
translations.idiomatic: That day fierce winds darkened the sky.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，以前鎮州節度使、涇王從敏為宋州節度使。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yihai, former Zhen prefecture military commissioner and Prince of Jing Cong Min was made Song prefecture military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the second month former Zhenzhou commissioner and Prince of Jing Cong Min became Songzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以前徐州節度使、檢校太傅李敬周為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao former Xu prefecture military commissioner, honorary Grand Tutor Li Jingzhou was made An prefecture military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao former Xuzhou commissioner and honorary grand tutor Li Jingzhou became Anzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是日，宣授鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂為權北京留守；

translations.literal: That day by edict Fengxiang military commissioner and Prince of Lu Cong Ke was made acting Northern Capital regent;
translations.idiomatic: That day Fengxiang commissioner and Prince of Lu Cong Ke was named acting Northern Capital regent;

sentences.zh: 以北京留守石敬瑭權知鎮州軍州事；

translations.literal: Northern Capital regent Shi Jingtang was made acting Zhen prefecture military and prefectural commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Northern Capital regent Shi Jingtang was made acting Zhenzhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以鎮州範延光權知鄴都留守事；

translations.literal: Zhen prefecture Fan Yanguang was made acting regent of the Yedu capital;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang of Zhenzhou became acting regent of Yedu;

sentences.zh: 以前河中節度使、洋王從璋權知鳳翔軍軍府事。

translations.literal: Former Hezhong military commissioner and Prince of Yang Cong Zhang was made acting Fengxiang army military and headquarters commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hezhong commissioner and Prince of Yang Cong Zhang became acting Fengxiang headquarters commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸山陵工作所。

translations.literal: On gengyin he visited the imperial tomb construction site.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he inspected the imperial tomb construction site.

sentences.zh: 是日，西京留守王思同奏，鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂拒命。

translations.literal: That day Western Capital regent Wang Sitong reported that Fengxiang military commissioner and Prince of Lu Cong Ke had defied orders.
translations.idiomatic: That day Western Capital regent Wang Sitong reported that Fengxiang commissioner and Prince of Lu Cong Ke was defying orders.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，王思同加同平章事，充西面行營都部署；

translations.literal: On dingyou Wang Sitong was additionally made Associate Grand Councilor and filled the post of overall commander of the Western Campaign Headquarters;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wang Sitong was also named associate grand councilor and overall commander of the western campaign;

sentences.zh: 以前邠州節度使藥彥稠為副部署。

translations.literal: Former Bin prefecture military commissioner Yao Yanchou was made deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Former Binzhou commissioner Yao Yanchou became deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 以河中節度使安彥威為西面兵馬都監，以前定州節度使李德充為權北京留守。

translations.literal: Hezhong military commissioner An Yanwei was made overall western horse-and-foot inspector; former Ding prefecture military commissioner Li Dechong was made acting Northern Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong commissioner An Yanwei became western horse-and-foot inspector; former Dingzhou commissioner Li Dechong became acting Northern Capital regent.

sentences.zh: 山陵使奏：「伏睹御劄，皇帝親奉靈駕至園陵。

translations.literal: The imperial tomb commissioner memorialized: "We have observed the imperial note that the Emperor personally escorts the spirit carriage to the imperial park tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb commissioner reported: "We have seen the emperor's note that he will personally escort the spirit carriage to the burial mound.

sentences.zh: 伏見累朝故事，人君無親送葬之儀，請車駕不行。

translations.literal: We observe successive dynasties' precedent—sovereigns have no rite of personally seeing off a burial; we request the imperial carriage not go.
translations.idiomatic: Past precedent shows sovereigns did not personally attend burials; we ask that the emperor not go.

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: " He did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 乙未，樞密使馮贇起復視事，時贇丁母憂也。

translations.literal: On yimao Military Affairs Commissioner Feng Yun resumed office after mourning leave; at the time Yun was in mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao military affairs commissioner Feng Yun returned from mourning; he was still in mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以司農卿張鎛為殿中監。

translations.literal: On jihai Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries Zhang Bo was made Director of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai granary director Zhang Bo became director of the palace domestic service.

sentences.zh: 庚子，殿直楚匡祚上言，監取亳州團練使李重吉至宋州，係於軍院。

translations.literal: On gengzi Palace Attendant Chu Kuangzuo submitted a memorial reporting that he had escorted Bo prefecture regiment trainer Li Chongji to Song prefecture and detained him in the military compound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi palace attendant Chu Kuangzuo reported that he had escorted Bo prefecture regiment trainer Li Chongji to Songzhou and detained him in the garrison compound.

sentences.zh: 重吉，潞王之長子，及幽於宋州，帝猶以金帛賜之，及聞西師鹹叛，方遣使殺之。

translations.literal: Chongji was the Prince of Lu's eldest son; though confined at Song prefecture, the Emperor still sent gold and silk to him—and only upon hearing that the western army had all rebelled did he send an envoy to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Chongji was the Prince of Lu's eldest son. Though imprisoned at Songzhou, the emperor still sent him gifts—until he learned the western army had rebelled, when he sent agents to kill him.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，以前太僕少卿魏仁鍔為太僕卿。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiachen, former Court of the Imperial Stud junior director Wei Ren'e was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the third month former stud junior director Wei Ren'e became stud director.

sentences.zh: 興元節度使張虔釗奏，會合討鳳翔。

translations.literal: Xingyuan military commissioner Zhang Qianzhao reported that forces had assembled to attack Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyuan commissioner Zhang Qianzhao reported that allied forces were converging to attack Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以右領衛上將軍武延翰為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingwu Right Lead Guard senior general Wu Yanhan was made E prefectural governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Right Lead Guard senior general Wu Yanhan became prefect of E.

sentences.zh: 丁未，洋州孫漢韶奏，至興元與張虔釗同議進軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei Yang prefecture Sun Hanzhao reported that he had reached Xingyuan and jointly deliberated advancing the army with Zhang Qianzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Sun Hanzhao of Yangzhou reported reaching Xingyuan to plan the advance with Zhang Qianzhao.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以鎮州節度使範延光依前檢校太師、兼侍中，行興唐尹，充天雄軍節度使、北面水陸轉運製置使；

translations.literal: On jiyou Zhen prefecture military commissioner Fan Yanguang retained honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant, acting Xing Tang prefect, filling the post of Tianxiong army military commissioner and northern land-and-water transport commissioner and commissioner for arrangements;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Fan Yanguang of Zhenzhou kept honorary grand preceptor and palace attendant, became acting Xing Tang prefect, and was named Tianxiong commissioner and northern land-and-water transport commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以北京留守、河東節度使石敬瑭依前檢校太尉、兼中書令，其真定尹、充鎮州節度使、大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管如故。

translations.literal: Northern Capital regent and Hedong military commissioner Shi Jingtang retained honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat—the posts of Zhending prefect, Zhen prefecture military commissioner, and overall commander of Han and barbarian horse and foot of the Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies as before.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Capital regent and Hedong commissioner Shi Jingtang kept honorary grand commandant and director of the Secretariat, continuing as Zhending prefect, Zhenzhou commissioner, and overall commander of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and allied forces.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以前定州節度使李德充為北京留守，充河東節度使。

translations.literal: On xinhai former Ding prefecture military commissioner Li Dechong was made Northern Capital regent and Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai former Dingzhou commissioner Li Dechong became Northern Capital regent and Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 許王從益加檢校太保，前河中節度使、洋王從璋加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Prince of Xu Cong Yi was additionally made honorary Grand Guardian; former Hezhong military commissioner and Prince of Yang Cong Zhang was additionally made honorary Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xu Cong Yi was also named honorary grand guardian; former Hezhong commissioner and Prince of Yang Cong Zhang was also named honorary grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 詔：「藩侯帶平章事以上薨，許立神道碑，差官撰文。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "When frontier lords bearing Associate Grand Councilor rank or above die, they may erect spirit-way steles; officials shall be dispatched to compose the text.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "When a frontier lord of associate grand councilor rank or higher dies, a spirit-way stele may be erected and an official appointed to write the inscription.

sentences.zh: 未帶平章事及刺史，準令式合立碑者，其文任自製撰，不在奏聞。

translations.literal: For those not bearing Associate Grand Councilor rank or prefectural governor rank, where regulations and formulas permitted stele erection, the text might be composed at will and need not be reported in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Those without associate grand councilor rank or a prefecture who were nonetheless entitled to a stele under statute could compose the inscription themselves without submitting it for approval.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，興元張虔釗奏，自鎮將兵赴鳳翔，收大散關。

translations.literal: " On yimao Xingyuan Zhang Qianzhao reported that he had led troops from his command to Fengxiang to recover Dasan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: " On yimao Zhang Qianzhao of Xingyuan reported leading troops from his post to Fengxiang to retake Dasan Pass.

sentences.zh: 宗正寺奏：「準故事，諸陵有令、丞各一員，近例更委本縣令兼之。

translations.literal: The Court of the Imperial Clan reported: "According to precedent, each imperial tomb had one director and one aide; recent practice further assigned these to the local county prefect concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of the Imperial Clan reported: "By precedent each imperial tomb had one director and one aide; recently the local county prefect had been assigned both posts.

sentences.zh: 緣河南洛陽是京邑，兼令、丞不便。

translations.literal: Because Henan and Luoyang are the capital region, concurrent holding of director and aide posts is inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Because Henan and Luoyang formed the capital region, holding both posts concurrently was impractical.

sentences.zh: 」詔特置陵台令、丞各一員。

translations.literal: " An edict specially established one Tomb Platform director and one aide each.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict then created dedicated Tomb Platform director and aide posts, one of each.

sentences.zh: 己未，以前金吾大將軍李肅為左衛上將軍，充山陵修奉上下宮都部署。

translations.literal: On jiwei former Golden Guard senior general Li Su was made Left Guard senior general, filling the post of overall director for upper and lower palace tomb repair and maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei former Golden Guard senior general Li Su became Left Guard senior general and overall director of upper and lower palace tomb works.

sentences.zh: 庚申，西面步軍都監王景從等自軍前至，奏：「今月十五日，大軍進攻鳳翔。

translations.literal: On gengshen Western Infantry overall supervisor Wang Jingcong and others arrived from the front and reported: "On the fifteenth of this month the main army advanced to attack Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Jingcong, Western Infantry overall supervisor, and others arrived from the front and reported: "On the fifteenth the main army attacked Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 十六日，嚴衛右廂都指揮使尹暉引軍東面入城，右羽林都指揮使楊思權引軍西面入城，山南軍潰。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth, Yanwei Right Wing overall commander Yin Hui led troops entering the city from the east; Right Imperial Guard overall commander Yang Siquan led troops entering from the west; the Shannan army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth Yanwei Right Wing commander Yin Hui entered from the east and Right Imperial Guard commander Yang Siquan from the west; the Shannan army broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 」帝聞之，謂康義誠等曰：「朕幼年嗣位，委政大臣，兄弟之間，必無榛梗。

translations.literal: " Hearing this, the Emperor said to Kang Yicheng and others: "I succeeded to the throne in youth and entrusted governance to senior ministers—between brothers there surely would be no brambles blocking the way.
translations.idiomatic: " When the emperor heard this he told Kang Yicheng and the others: "I took the throne young and left affairs to my ministers; between brothers there should be no thorns in the path.

sentences.zh: 諸公大計見告，朕獨難違，事至於此，何方轉禍？

translations.literal: You have informed me of your great plan; I alone find it hard to refuse. Now that matters have reached this pass, by what means may disaster be turned?
translations.idiomatic: You have told me your plan, and I alone find it hard to refuse. Now that things have come to this, how can we turn disaster aside?

sentences.zh: 朕當與左右自往鳳翔，迎兄主社稷；

translations.literal: I shall go in person with my attendants to Fengxiang to welcome my elder brother to preside over the altars of state;
translations.idiomatic: I shall go myself with my attendants to Fengxiang to welcome my elder brother to rule the realm;

sentences.zh: 朕自歸藩，於理為便。

translations.literal: and I myself shall return to my fief—this would be proper in principle.
translations.idiomatic: and I shall return to my fief, which would be the proper course.

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭、馮贇不對，義誠曰：「西師驚潰，蓋由主將失策。

translations.literal: " Zhu Hongzhao and Feng Yun did not reply. Yicheng said: "The western army's panic and rout were surely due to the commander-in-chief's faulty strategy.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhu Hongzhao and Feng Yun said nothing. Yicheng replied: "The western army panicked and broke because the commander blundered.

sentences.zh: 今駕下兵甲尚多，臣請自往關西，振其兵威，扼其衝要。

translations.literal: Under Your Majesty's command there are still many troops and armor; your servant requests to go personally to Guanxi, raise their martial prestige, and choke their vital passes.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty still has many troops at hand. I ask to go west myself, restore their fighting spirit, and hold the key passes.

sentences.zh: 」義誠又累奏請行，帝召侍衛都將以下宣曰：「先皇帝棄萬國，朕於兄弟之中，無心爭立，一旦被召主喪，便委社稷，岐陽兄長，果致猜嫌。

translations.literal: " Yicheng repeatedly memorialized requesting to go. The Emperor summoned the Palace Guard generals down and declared: "When the late emperor abandoned the myriad states, among brothers I had no heart to contend for enthronement—suddenly summoned to preside over mourning, I entrusted the altars; my elder brother at Qiyang indeed came to suspicion and estrangement.
translations.idiomatic: " Yicheng memorialized again and again to go. The emperor summoned the palace guard generals and declared: "When the late emperor died I had no wish among my brothers to seize the throne; once summoned to lead the mourning I took the realm, and my elder brother at Qiyang has indeed grown suspicious.

sentences.zh: 卿等頃從先朝千征萬戰，今日之事，寧不痛心！

translations.literal: You all lately followed the late court through a thousand campaigns and myriad battles—today's affair, how could it not pierce the heart!
translations.idiomatic: You followed the late emperor through countless campaigns—how can today's events not break your hearts!

sentences.zh: 今據府庫，悉以頒賜，卿等勉之！

translations.literal: Now drawing on the treasury, all shall be distributed as gifts—do your utmost!
translations.idiomatic: I shall open the treasury and give you everything—do your best!

sentences.zh: 」乃出銀絹錢厚賜於諸軍。

translations.literal: " Silver, silk, and cash were generously distributed to the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: " He then distributed silver, silk, and cash in generous gifts to the armies.

sentences.zh: 是時方事山陵，復有此賜，府藏為之一空，軍士猶負賞物揚言於路曰：「到鳳翔更請一分。

translations.literal: At this time tomb construction was underway; with this added largesse the treasury stores were emptied, yet soldiers still shouldering reward goods proclaimed along the road: "When we reach Fengxiang we shall ask for another share.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb works were already draining the treasury, and this largesse emptied it completely; soldiers still carrying their rewards shouted in the streets: "When we reach Fengxiang we'll demand another share.

sentences.zh: 」其驕誕無畏如是。

translations.literal: " Their arrogance and insolence without fear were thus.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was their arrogance and brazen insolence.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸左藏庫，視給將士金帛。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Emperor visited the Left Treasury to oversee distribution of gold and silks to officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the emperor visited the Left Treasury to oversee gifts of gold and silk to officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 是日，誅馬軍都指揮使朱洪實，坐與康義誠忿爭故也。

translations.literal: That day Horse Army overall commander Zhu Hongshi was executed for quarreling angrily with Kang Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: That day Horse Army commander Zhu Hongshi was executed for quarreling with Kang Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以康義誠為鳳翔行營都招討使，餘如故。

translations.literal: On guihai Kang Yicheng was made overall commander-and-pacifier of the Fengxiang mobile headquarters, other posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Kang Yicheng became overall commander of the Fengxiang field headquarters; his other posts were unchanged.

sentences.zh: 以王思同為副招討使；

translations.literal: Wang Sitong was made deputy commander-and-pacifier;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sitong was named deputy commander;

sentences.zh: 以安從進為順化軍節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: An Congjin was made Shunhua army military commissioner and filled the post of Palace Guard Horse Army overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin became Shunhua army commissioner and palace guard Horse Army commander.

sentences.zh: 詔左右羽林軍四十指揮改為嚴衛，左右龍武、神武軍改為捧聖。

translations.literal: An edict changed the forty commands of Left and Right Imperial Guards to Yanwei, and Left and Right Dragon Martial and Divine Martial armies to Paladin-Sacred.
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed the forty Left and Right Imperial Guard commands as Yanwei and the Left and Right Dragon Martial and Divine Martial armies as Paladin-Sacred.

sentences.zh: 甲子，陝州奏，潞王至潼關，害西面都部署王思同。

translations.literal: On jiazi Shan prefecture reported: the Prince of Lu reached Tong Pass and killed Western overall director Wang Sitong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Shanzhou reported that the Prince of Lu had reached Tong Pass and killed Western overall director Wang Sitong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宣諭西面行營將士，俟平鳳翔日，人賞二百千，府庫不足，以宮闈服玩增給。

translations.literal: On yihai an announcement instructed the western mobile headquarters officers and soldiers: when Fengxiang is pacified each man shall receive two hundred strings; if the treasury is insufficient, palace women's garments and curios shall supplement the distribution.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the western field army was promised two hundred strings per man once Fengxiang fell; if the treasury ran short, palace garments and curios would make up the difference.

sentences.zh: 詔侍衛馬軍都指揮使安從進京城巡檢。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Palace Guard Horse Army overall commander An Congjin to patrol the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered palace guard Horse Army commander An Congjin to patrol the capital.

sentences.zh: 是日，從進已得潞王書檄，潛布腹心矣。

translations.literal: That day Congjin had already received the Prince of Lu's written proclamations and secretly placed his trusted men.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Congjin had already received the Prince of Lu's proclamation and quietly posted his own agents throughout the city.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，潞王至陝州。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Prince of Lu reached Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Prince of Lu reached Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，帝急召孟漢瓊，不至；

translations.literal: On wuchen the Emperor urgently summoned Meng Hanqiong, who did not come;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the emperor urgently summoned Meng Hanqiong, who did not appear;

sentences.zh: 召朱宏昭，宏昭懼，投於井。

translations.literal: Zhu Hongzhao was summoned; in fear he threw himself into a well.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao was summoned; terrified, he threw himself into a well.

sentences.zh: 安從進尋殺馮贇於其第。

translations.literal: An Congjin soon killed Feng Yun at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin soon killed Feng Yun at his home.

sentences.zh: 是夜，帝以百騎出元武門，謂控鶴指揮使慕容遷曰：「爾誠有馬，控鶴從予。

translations.literal: That night the Emperor with a hundred riders exited the Xuanyuan Gate and said to Crane-Control commander Murong Qian: "If you truly have horses, let Crane-Control follow me.
translations.idiomatic: That night the emperor rode out Xuanyuan Gate with a hundred horsemen and told Crane-Control commander Murong Qian: "If you truly have horses, bring Crane-Control and follow me.

sentences.zh: 」及駕出，即闔門不行。

translations.literal: " When the imperial carriage exited, the gate was immediately closed and they did not go.
translations.idiomatic: " Once the emperor was out, the gate was shut and they did not follow.

sentences.zh: 遷乃帝素親信者也，臨危如是，人皆惡之。

translations.literal: Qian had been the Emperor's long-trusted intimate; to act thus at crisis—all loathed him.
translations.idiomatic: Qian had long been the emperor's trusted favorite; to abandon him at the crisis earned universal contempt.

sentences.zh: 是月二十九日夜，帝至衛州東七八里，遇騎從自東來不避，左右叱之，乃曰：「鎮州節度使石敬瑭也。

translations.literal: On the night of the twenty-ninth of that month, the Emperor reached seven or eight li east of Weizhou; encountering mounted followers coming from the east who did not yield, his attendants shouted at them—they said: "It is Zhen prefecture military commissioner Shi Jingtang.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-ninth the emperor reached a spot seven or eight li east of Weizhou. Horsemen approached from the east without yielding; when his attendants shouted, they answered: "It is Zhenzhou commissioner Shi Jingtang.

sentences.zh: 」帝喜，敬瑭拜舞於路，帝下馬慟哭，諭以「潞王危社稷，康義誠以下叛我，無以自庇，長公主見教，逆爾於路，謀社稷大計。

translations.literal: " The Emperor rejoiced; Jingtang bowed and danced on the road; the Emperor dismounted and wept bitterly, instructing him: "The Prince of Lu endangers the altars; Kang Yicheng and those below have rebelled against me—I have nowhere to shield myself. The Eldest Princess instructed me to meet you on the road and plot the great design for the altars.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor rejoiced. Jingtang bowed on the road; the emperor dismounted and wept, telling him: "The Prince of Lu threatens the realm; Kang Yicheng and the rest have turned against me and I have nowhere to hide. The Eldest Princess urged me to meet you here and plan for the state.

sentences.zh: 」敬瑭曰：「衛州王宏贄宿舊諳事，且就宏贄圖之。

translations.literal: " Jingtang said: "Weizhou's Wang Hongzan is an old acquaintance versed in affairs—let us go to Hongzan and plan.
translations.idiomatic: " Jingtang said: "Wang Hongzan of Weizhou is an old friend who knows how things are done—let us consult him.

sentences.zh: 」敬瑭即馳騎而前，見宏贄曰：「主上播遷，至此危迫，吾戚屬也，何以圖全？

translations.literal: " Jingtang immediately galloped ahead and, seeing Hongzan, said: "The sovereign is cast into wandering and has reached this critical pass—I am his kin by marriage; how may we plan for his preservation?
translations.idiomatic: " Jingtang galloped ahead and said to Hongzan: "The sovereign is in flight and in grave danger. I am his kinsman by marriage—how can we keep him safe?

sentences.zh: 」宏贄曰：「天子避狄，古亦有之，然於奔迫之中，亦有將相、國寶、法物，所以軍長瞻奉，不覺其亡也。

translations.literal: " Hongzan said: "That the Son of Heaven flees barbarian invasion—antiquity has known this too; yet in the rush of flight there are still generals and ministers, national treasures, and ritual objects, so army leaders look up and serve and do not perceive his fall.
translations.idiomatic: " Hongzan replied: "Emperors have fled invaders before, but even in flight they still had ministers, regalia, and ritual objects so commanders could see and serve them and not know the throne was lost.

sentences.zh: 今宰職近臣從乎？

translations.literal: Are chief ministers and close attendants following now?
translations.idiomatic: Do chief ministers and close attendants follow him now?

sentences.zh: 寶玉、法物從乎？

translations.literal: Are jade treasures and ritual objects following?
translations.idiomatic: Do jade treasures and ritual regalia follow?

sentences.zh: 」詢之無有。

translations.literal: " Inquiry found none.
translations.idiomatic: " There were none.

sentences.zh: 宏贄曰：「大樹將顛，非一繩所維。

translations.literal: Hongzan said: "When a great tree is about to topple, one rope alone cannot hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzan said: "When a great tree is falling, one rope cannot hold it up.

sentences.zh: 今以五十騎奔竄，無將相一人擁從，安能興復大計！

translations.literal: Now fleeing with only fifty riders, not one general or minister attending—how can a great design of restoration be raised!
translations.idiomatic: He flees with fifty horsemen and not a single minister or general—how can he hope to restore the throne!

sentences.zh: 所謂蛟龍失雲雨者也。

translations.literal: This is what is called a dragon losing cloud and rain.
translations.idiomatic: This is a dragon without cloud and rain.

sentences.zh: 今六軍將士總在潞邸矣，公縱以戚藩念舊，無奈之何！

translations.literal: " Now the Six Armies' officers and soldiers are all at the Prince of Lu's residence; though you may by kinship and fief recall old ties, nothing can be done!
translations.idiomatic: " The armies are all with the Prince of Lu now; however much kinship moves you, nothing can be done!

sentences.zh: 」遂與宏贄同謁於驛亭，宣坐謀之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon with Hongzan they jointly presented themselves at the relay station pavilion, and the Emperor was seated to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: " They then went with Hongzan to the relay station, where the emperor was seated to confer.

sentences.zh: 敬瑭以宏贄所陳以聞，弓箭庫使沙守榮、奔洪進前謂敬瑭曰：「主上即明宗愛子，公即明宗愛婿，富貴既同受，休戚合共之。

translations.literal: Jingtang reported Hongzan's statements; Bow-and-Arrow Store envoy Sha Shourong and Ben Hongjin stepped forward and said to Jingtang: "The sovereign is Mingzong's beloved son; you are Mingzong's beloved son-in-law—wealth and honor you have received together; weal and woe should be shared.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang relayed Hongzan's words. Bow-and-Arrow Store envoy Sha Shourong and Ben Hongjin stepped forward and told Jingtang: "The sovereign is Mingzong's beloved son and you his beloved son-in-law; you shared his favor and should share his fate.

sentences.zh: 今謀於戚藩，欲期安復，翻索從臣、國寶，欲以此為辭，為賊算天子耶！

translations.literal: Now plotting with a kinsman's fief, hoping for safe restoration, yet he instead demands attending ministers and national treasures—seeking to use this as pretext—is this calculating the sovereign for the rebels!
translations.idiomatic: You seek restoration through a kinsman's domain, yet he demands ministers and regalia as excuses—is this bargaining the emperor away to the rebels!

sentences.zh: 」乃抽佩刀刺敬瑭，敬瑭親將陳暉捍之，守榮與暉單戰而死，洪進亦自刎。

translations.literal: " Drawing their girdle swords they stabbed at Jingtang; Jingtang's personal officer Chen Hui defended him; Shourong and Hui fought singly and died; Hongjin also slit his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: " They drew their swords and stabbed at Jingtang. His personal officer Chen Hui defended him; Shourong and Hui fought alone and died, and Hongjin cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 是日，敬瑭盡誅帝之從騎五十餘輩，獨留帝於驛，乃馳騎趨洛。

translations.literal: That day Jingtang executed to the last the Emperor's fifty-odd accompanying riders, leaving the Emperor alone at the relay station, then galloped toward Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: That day Jingtang killed all fifty-odd of the emperor's escort, left the emperor alone at the relay station, and galloped toward Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：閔帝爰自衝年，素有令問，及征從代邸，入踐堯階，屬軒皇之弓劍初遺，吳王之几杖未賜，遽生猜間，遂至奔亡。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Emperor Min from his tender years had long borne a fine reputation; when summoned from the Dai residence he entered and trod Yao's steps—just as Yellow Emperor's bow and sword were newly bequeathed and the King of Wu's armrest and staff not yet bestowed, suddenly suspicion arose between them, leading to flight and ruin.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Emperor Min had been admired from youth; summoned from the Dai residence he ascended Yao's throne—yet while the Yellow Emperor's bow and sword were still fresh in hand and the King of Wu's seat and staff not yet granted, suspicion sprang up at once and drove him to flight and ruin.

sentences.zh: 蓋輔臣無安國之謀，非少主有不君之咎。

translations.literal: Surely the assisting ministers lacked plans to secure the state—it was not that the young sovereign had the fault of unsovereign conduct.
translations.idiomatic: The fault lay with ministers who lacked a plan to secure the realm, not with a young emperor who had done nothing unworthy of the throne.

sentences.zh: 以至越在草莽，失守宗祧，斯蓋天命之難忱，土德之將謝故也。

translations.literal: Thus reaching exile in the wilds and losing the ancestral shrine—this surely was because Heavenly mandate was hard to rely upon and the virtue of Earth was about to decline.
translations.idiomatic: That he ended wandering in the wilds and lost the ancestral shrine shows Heaven's mandate could no longer be trusted and the virtue of Earth was fading away.
